types.name: Working together
types.description: Each person’s time to finish the work alone is given (or the time together), and you must find the time together or one person’s time alone.

types.name: Efficiency comparison
types.description: The question says one worker is k times (or x% more) efficient than another, or gives the ratio of efficiencies, and asks for a time.

types.name: Pairs and groups (men, women, boys)
types.description: Times are given for pairs such as A + B, B + C and C + A, or for groups of men, women and children whose work rates are compared.

types.name: Men, days and hours (chain rule)
types.description: The number of men, days, hours per day or amount of work changes, and you find the missing quantity using M × D × H ÷ W.

types.name: Someone leaves or joins midway
types.description: Workers start together and one leaves, joins or is replaced after some days (or a few days before the end), and the rest finish the work.

types.name: Working on alternate days
types.description: Workers or pipes work in turns, on alternate days or hours, in a repeating cycle.

types.name: Pipes, cisterns and leaks
types.description: Inlet pipes fill and outlet pipes or leaks empty a tank, so some rates are negative.

types.name: Wages shared by work done
types.description: A payment for the whole job is split among workers in the ratio of the work each one did, or daily wages are compared.
